[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) in PHP"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) are essential practices for modern software development. They automate the process of integrating code changes, testing, and deploying applications, leading to faster release cycles, improved code quality, and reduced risk. This tutorial will guide you through implementing CI/CD for PHP projects."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding CI/CD Principles"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Continuous Integration (CI): Regularly merging code changes from multiple developers into a central repository, followed by automated builds and tests."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Continuous Deployment (CD): Automatically deploying code changes to production or staging environments after successful CI."},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Tools for PHP CI/CD"},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Git: Version control system for managing code changes."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Jenkins: Popular open-source automation server."},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"GitLab CI/CD: Integrated CI/CD pipeline within GitLab."},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"GitHub Actions: CI/CD directly integrated into GitHub repositories."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Travis CI: Cloud-based CI/CD service."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Docker: Containerization platform for consistent environments."},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Setting up a CI/CD Pipeline with GitLab CI/CD (Example)"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"This example demonstrates using GitLab CI/CD. The process is similar for other CI/CD tools."},{"order":15,"type":"paragraph","text":"1. Create a `.gitlab-ci.yml` file in the root of your PHP project."},{"order":16,"type":"code","text":"# .gitlab-ci.yml

stages:
  - build
  - test
  - deploy

build_job:
  stage: build
  image: composer:latest
  script:
    - composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - vendor/

test_job:
  stage: test
  image: php:7.4-cli
  dependencies:
    - build_job
  script:
    - phpunit

deploy_job:
  stage: deploy
  image: alpine/ssh
  dependencies:
    - test_job
  before_script:
    - apk update && apk add openssh-client
    - mkdir -p ~/.ssh
    - echo "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" | tr -d '\r' > ~/.ssh/id_rsa
    - chmod 400 ~/.ssh/id_rsa
    - ssh-keyscan example.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
    - chmod 400 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
  script:
    - ssh user@example.com "
        cd /var/www/your-project;
        git pull origin main;
        php artisan migrate;
        php artisan cache:clear;
      "
  only:
    - main"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"2. **Explanation of `.gitlab-ci.yml`:**"},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"`stages`: Defines the stages of the pipeline (build, test, deploy)."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"`build_job`: Installs PHP dependencies using Composer."},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":"`test_job`: Runs PHPUnit tests.  Requires the `build_job` to complete successfully."},{"order":21,"type":"bullet_point","text":"`deploy_job`: Deploys the code to a remote server via SSH. Requires the `test_job` to complete successfully."},{"order":22,"type":"paragraph","text":"3. **Configure SSH Key:**"},{"order":23,"type":"paragraph","text":"Add an SSH private key as a CI/CD variable named `SSH_PRIVATE_KEY` in GitLab. This key will be used to authenticate with the remote server."},{"order":24,"type":"paragraph","text":"4. **Configure the remote server:**"},{"order":25,"type":"paragraph","text":"Ensure that the user on the remote server has the necessary permissions to access the project directory and execute the deployment commands."},{"order":26,"type":"subheading","text":"Testing"},{"order":27,"type":"paragraph","text":"Automated testing is a crucial part of CI/CD.  Use PHPUnit or other testing frameworks to write unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests."},{"order":28,"type":"code","text":"<!-- Example PHPUnit test -->
<?php

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ExampleTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testAddition(): void
    {
        $this->assertEquals(4, 2 + 2);
    }
}"},{"order":29,"type":"subheading","text":"Deployment Strategies"},{"order":30,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Blue/Green Deployment: Maintain two identical environments (blue and green). Deploy new code to the inactive environment, test it, and then switch traffic to the new environment."},{"order":31,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Rolling Deployment: Gradually update instances in the production environment, minimizing downtime."},{"order":32,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Canary Deployment: Release new code to a small subset of users to test its stability before rolling it out to everyone."},{"order":33,"type":"subheading","text":"Benefits of CI/CD"},{"order":34,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Faster release cycles."},{"order":35,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Improved code quality."},{"order":36,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Reduced risk of deployment failures."},{"order":37,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Increased developer productivity."},{"order":38,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":39,"type":"paragraph","text":"Implementing CI/CD for your PHP projects can significantly improve your development workflow and deliver value to your users faster. Choose the tools and strategies that best fit your needs and start automating your software delivery pipeline."}]
